blocks.caption: Common problems
rows: Simulation becomes very slow
Check `memory`; restart MATLAB and reopen the project
Accelerator mode fails when the MEX file loads
Windows Application Control blocks it on this PC; use Normal mode (default)
`Stateflow:Assertion o != nullptr` on the first compile
Run again (`run_scenario` retries automatically)
Robot does not move
Check `S.telem.mode` = 3 (MANUAL); arm after STANDBY with sticks at 0 and the transmitter on; after an E-stop or RC loss, reset and cycle the arm switch
RC link lost in the first 0.5 s
Normal: the transmitter switches on at 0.5 s
HV_Ready never rises in a direct model run
Run `P = scn_integration_overrides(P)` first
Code generation BLOCKED
Install Simulink Coder, then `shaddad_configsets('codegen')`
A run ends with `ok=0`
Read `r.msg` for the error text
`No USB controller found`
Connect the PS5 controller or the transmitter (USB Joystick mode); check with `phase1_joystick_check`
Nothing happens after `Controller found`
The model is compiling (2-3 min the first time); wait for the 3-D window
Live drive: robot does not arm
Sticks centred, then Cross (PS5) or CH6 (RC); after an E-stop first Triangle / CH9 reset
Live drive: steering or throttle reversed
Flip the sign in `scen.joy.pad.inv_*` (PS5) or `scen.joy.inv` (RC), run `shaddad_params`
`plot_run`: a tile says `not logged in this run`
Normal for parts the model variant does not run (for example navigation in Phase 1); see {sec:um06_results}
